name: SQL_MCP
description: An MCP server that provides AI agents with structured read access to a SQL Server database � schemas, stored procedures, foreign key dependencies, code search, and data sampling.

tools.name: get_object_definition
tools.description: Returns the full T-SQL definition of a stored procedure, view, or function. Use filter to retrieve only lines surrounding a specific keyword instead of the full body.

filter.description: Keyword to find within the body — returns only the ±15 lines around each match instead of the full definition.

catalog.description: Database to query (leave empty for default).

tools.name: search_database_code
tools.description: Searches the raw SQL text definitions of all stored procedures, views, and functions for a specific keyword, table name, or column name. Useful for tracing dependencies, finding where a specific table is updated, or locating poorly-named logic across the database.

search_term.description: The keyword, variable, or object name to search for within the database code.

tools.name: get_table_schema
tools.description: Retrieves the database schema details for a specific table. Returns a structured list of column names, their specific SQL data types, maximum character lengths, and whether they allow NULL values. Use this to understand the data contract before writing queries or application models.

table_name.description: The exact name of the database table (e.g., 'Users' or 'dbo.Orders').

tools.name: get_table_dependencies
tools.description: Retrieves all Foreign Key relationships associated with a specific table. Returns data showing where the table acts as a parent (referenced by others) and where it acts as a child (referencing others). Crucial for understanding entity relationships and writing accurate JOIN statements.

table_name.description: The exact name of the database table to check for foreign key dependencies.

tools.name: get_data_sample
tools.description: Retrieves a safe, highly limited sample (TOP 5 rows) of actual data from a specific table. Use this tool to inspect real-world data formatting, understand the actual values of enumerations/status codes, and verify edge cases that the schema alone does not explain.

table_name.description: The exact name of the database table to sample.

tools.name: list_schemas
tools.description: Lists all user-defined schemas in the database. Call this first on any unfamiliar database to understand how objects are partitioned before calling list_tables or list_objects.

tools.name: list_tables
tools.description: Lists all user tables in the database, optionally filtered by schema. Use this as your first step when exploring an unfamiliar database � never guess table names.

schema.description: Optional schema name to filter by (e.g., 'dbo', 'core'). Leave empty to list tables from all schemas.

tools.name: list_objects
tools.description: Lists all stored procedures, views, or functions in the database, optionally filtered by schema and/or object type. Use this to discover what code exists before searching inside it.

schema.description: Optional schema name to filter by. Leave empty for all schemas.

type.description: Optional object type filter: 'procedure', 'view', 'function'. Leave empty for all types.

tools.name: get_view_definition
tools.description: Retrieves the full T-SQL definition of a specific view.

view_name.description: The exact name of the view (e.g., 'vw_ActiveOrders' or 'dbo.vw_ActiveOrders').

tools.name: get_function_definition
tools.description: Retrieves the full T-SQL definition of a specific scalar or table-valued function.

function_name.description: The exact name of the function (e.g., 'fn_GetDiscount' or 'dbo.fn_GetDiscount').

tools.name: search_columns
tools.description: Finds all tables that contain a column matching the given name or partial name.

column_name.description: The column name or partial name to search for (e.g., 'StatusID', 'Customer').

tools.name: get_indexes
tools.description: Retrieves all indexes defined on a specific table including column membership, uniqueness, and clustering. Use this before writing queries on large tables.

table_name.description: The exact name of the database table.

tools.name: get_triggers
tools.description: Retrieves all triggers defined on a specific table including their full T-SQL body. Triggers often contain hidden business logic not visible in stored procedures.

table_name.description: The exact name of the database table.

tools.name: run_query
tools.description: Executes a read-only SELECT query and returns results (capped at 200 rows). Only SELECT statements are permitted � all write and DDL statements are rejected.

query.description: A valid read-only SELECT statement to execute.

tools.name: get_row_counts
tools.description: Returns the approximate row count for all tables using SQL Server internal statistics. Call this before querying to understand data volume.

schema.description: Optional schema name to filter by. Leave empty for all tables.

tools.name: get_sproc_parameters
tools.description: Returns just the parameter signature of a stored procedure — names, types, direction, and defaults — without fetching the full body.

sproc_name.description: The exact name of the stored procedure.

tools.name: list_ssis_servers
tools.description: Lists the configured SSIS server labels that can be passed to server_label parameters.

tools.name: resolve_ssis_package
tools.description: Resolves a package name (or partial name) to the full folder/project/package/server_label needed by other endpoints. Use this first when you only know the package name.

package_name.description: Full or partial package name to search for.

tools.name: list_ssis_folders
tools.description: Lists all SSIS catalog folders across all configured servers.

tools.name: list_ssis_projects
tools.description: Lists SSIS projects in a catalog folder.

folder_name.description: Folder name to list projects from. Use list_ssis_folders to discover.

tools.name: list_ssis_packages
tools.description: Lists SSIS packages in a project.

tools.name: get_ssis_package_parameters
tools.description: Returns parameters for an SSIS package.

tools.name: get_ssis_project_parameters
tools.description: Returns project-level parameters for an SSIS project.

tools.name: get_ssis_environment_references
tools.description: Returns environment references and their variables for an SSIS project. Shows which environments are linked and what values they provide.

tools.name: search_ssis_packages
tools.description: Searches SSIS package names across all servers for a keyword. Returns folder/project/package per match with server labels - use these values directly in other endpoints.

search_term.description: Keyword to search for in package names.

tools.name: get_ssis_execution_history
tools.description: Returns recent execution history for an SSIS package. Set latest_only to get the most recent execution with inline error messages.

latest_only.description: If true, returns only the latest execution and includes error messages inline if it failed.

tools.name: get_ssis_execution_errors
tools.description: Returns error messages for a specific SSIS execution.

server_label.description: Server label from list_ssis_servers. Identifies which server the execution ran on.

tools.name: get_ssis_package_definition
tools.description: Returns a summarized view of an SSIS package: tasks, data flows, precedence constraints, and connection managers parsed from the package XML.

server_label.description: Server label: 'MainServer' or 'SsisServer'. Leave empty to search both.

tools.name: get_ssis_dataflow_details
tools.description: Returns details of a specific Data Flow task in an SSIS package: source/destination components, transformations, and column mappings.

dataflow_task_name.description: Name of the Data Flow task as shown in get_ssis_package_definition.

server_label.description: Server label. Leave empty to search both.

tools.name: get_ssis_sql_statements
tools.description: Extracts all inline SQL statements from an SSIS package — from Execute SQL tasks, OLE DB sources/destinations, and other components.

server_label.description: Server label. Leave empty to search both.

tools.name: search_ssis_package_content
tools.description: Searches the raw XML content of all SSIS packages for a keyword (table name, column, sproc, etc.). Finds which packages reference it.

search_term.description: Keyword to search for in package XML.

folder_name.description: Folder name to limit search scope.

project_name.description: Project name to limit search scope. Leave empty for all projects in the folder.
